title: How To Recognize It's Time For Change
text: [Music] I do an old chapter the book on that what how to recognize seasons of change number one when what you are doing is no longer effective it's time to change when the people around you begin to become an irritation instead of a blessing it's time for change when all your efforts seem to be causing more stress on you than causing blessings and fulfillment it's time to change in other words when winter comes everything cooperates with it what I'm saying is very important when when a season comes everything cooperates with it so when winter comes the leaves fall the bear goes into a cave the trees lose all their leaves you begin to see different plants going into recession they preparing for the change when a change is taking place things that were against you suddenly become for you people that said no before and now say yes change can be that traumatic
